formal_statement: have x1 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := [((0 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ))]; have x2 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x2 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => ∃ (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), (↑x3, ↑x4) ∈ x1 ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; have x3 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => (x2 x3 ∧ ∀ (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), x3 x4 = Bool.true → ¬x2 (Function.update x3 x4 Bool.false)) ∨ ¬x2 x3 ∧ ∀ (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), x3 x4 = Bool.false → x2 (Function.update x3 x4 Bool.true); ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x5 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), x5 = (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) ∨ x5 = (9 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → (∀ (x8 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x3 x8 → (x4.eval (List.ofFn x8 ++ [PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or.eval [x8 (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), x8 x5]]) = Bool.true ↔ x2 x8)) → (26 : ℕ) ≤ x4.size
plain_statement: Heawood graph as in the parent (21 edges, F its edge function on 14 inputs): for v = 7 or v = 9, an AND/OR fan-in-at-most-two circuit on 15 inputs that, with its last input fed x0 OR xv, agrees with F on every minimal true and every maximal false input, has at least 26 gates.
title: A step toward: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function of the Heawood graph has at least 27 gates
